method: Sequential unauthenticated HTTPS GETs; identity transfer encoding; one-MiB streaming hash chunks; exact expected byte/hash bounds; redirects restricted to the same public HTTPS alias. No cookies, authorization or protection bypass headers; no deployment, build, environment, API job or simulation action.

readiness_check.scope: Authenticated read-only deployment metadata. Every public-content GET and the Study verification use the unauthenticated public alias without cookies or bypass headers.

deployment_source_provenance: The deployment launcher supplied the source commit. CLI inspect confirms the exact deployment ID, unique URL and READY state; the served product is independently bound to the frozen product inventory.

notice_integrity.method: Each served file is byte-identical to the frozen inventory; the frozen combined notice and original license bodies are then checked without rewriting them.

verification.scope: Verifies the released public companions and their arithmetic; does not read or re-audit private raw simulator outcomes or prove human test nonaccess.

exclusive_test_claim.scope: Reconciles the released original claim, completed inventory and declared chronology. Public metadata does not independently prove absence of other private attempts, human nonaccess or the physical location of the original collection.

analysis_amendment.scope: Checks exact public pre-test descriptor/source/failure evidence identities, stopped/unsuccessful watcher status and declared chronology. The original journal has no fit-stage marker; the descriptor pre-fit assertion depends on the retained stack/log and reviewed absence of original output. Metadata does not independently prove human nonaccess or when fitting actually began.

scope_limits: Verifies the post-Canva production publication, exact static bytes, public arithmetic and frozen choices. Desktop interaction and rendering have separate acceptance records. The hosted viewer replays cached results; it does not run SUMO or train models on Vercel. Later media-only publication is outside this 61-file snapshot.
